newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BAA, Schiphol win Australia airports-papers.
newsitem.headline: BAA, Schiphol win Australia airports-papers.

text.p: A consortium led by the Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP) and British airports operator BAA Plc had been selected as the buyer of the government-owned Melbourne Airport, newspapers reported on Thursday.

"Government and industry sources confirmed yesterday that the APAC consortium, comprising British Airports Authority (BAA), AMP and Axiom Funds Management, was expected to be announced as the preferred bidder for the lease of Melbourne's Tullamarine Airport," The Australian Financial Review reported.

The Financial Review and The Sydney Morning Herald also reported that consortium led by the Commonwealth Bank of Australia and Dutch government-owned Schiphol airport would win the bid for Brisbane airport.
"A group led by the Commonwealth Bank and the Dutch Government-owned Amsterdam Airport Schiphol...is considered the favourite to win Brisbane Airport," the Herald said.
A Lend Lease Corp /Brambles Industries Ltd consortium was favoured to win the bid for Perth airport, it said.
